decks.title: Tempo Riftbeast

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Brambleback items. Murkwolf can hold items.
Aim to get 7 Riftbeast online latest by Stage 3-5. Use free Riftbeast shops to upgrade only instead of rerolling. Finish Bramble / tank items.
Level to 8 and look for Bramble + Brawler or Rakan. Always play Elder Dragon when you hit. Once stable, go 9 for another 5 cost.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Alpha Mark the Brambleback. Strong with any augment that gives you +1 team size so you can fit in another carry.

decks.title: Lunarwood Kha'zix

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively on Kha'zix and move them later. It's okay to have Spark, Shojin, etc on Khazix early for takedowns.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, give leftover AP items to Diana.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: If you have HOJ first, go Executioner > Ravager. If you have AP / Mana / tempo slams, go Ravager > Executioner. Then pick Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions. Can play 3rd Executioner/Lux/Ivern as max cap.

decks.title: Azir Rammus

sourceTips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with Blossom opener for better charms. Take rods off carousel whenever possible.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Rammus 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Once you finish, level for more Summoner / Executioner.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: This comp requires lots of rods so take item augments early. Blackthorn sacrifice hex scales off gold value: 3* Teemo > 2* AP 4 cost that isn't holding items > 2* Teemo > 2* Veigar. Blackthorn Lux is a very strong win condition worth playing.

decks.title: Riftbeast Reroll

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Pebbles items. Alpha Mark Crab or Gromp.
Save up econ and try to go level 7  for 7 riftbeast on 3-5, if you're poor wait until 4-1.
Once you have your 3*, level to 8 and field 7 Riftbeast. If you can get to 9, you can ditch 1* Ravagers for Elder Dragon.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Use 5 Riftbeast shops to finish your 3* because you want to rush 7 Riftbeast on Level 7 ASAP. You can carry ALL of the riftbeast carries besides Mama Beak if you have items. Krug 3 is the best tank but you can also tank Sentinel 2 > Scuttle Crab 3. Alpha Mark Cinderling early > Crab late.

decks.title: Draven Ezreal 9

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Draven items. Ideal opener will be some kind of resource engine like Rengar or Blossom.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 end of Stage 4 and look for the scaling 5 costs like Draven, Maokai, and Ivern.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Only play from early win streak and lots of gold. Because you are aiming for scaling 5 costs, aim to level 9 around end of Stage 4 / beginning of Stage 5. Best Draven quests are dealing damage for gold, but avoid the 10k damage in 1 round because you can get trapped.

decks.title: Ahri Morgana

sourceTips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Morgana holds utility items. You can tank either Sentinel or Sett. Best emblem = Invoker on Ahri. Late game cap with Ashe + Alune over Karma.

decks.title: Elderwood Executioners

sourceTips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Soraka with 7 Elderwood. Try not to roll to 0g because we need gold to get to level 9.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Mainly strong with Elderwood emblem. Look for Elderwood Lux. 3 Executioner is a big spike so always look to play around it if possible. Can also chase 9 Elderwood if you have Elderwood Lux.

decks.title: Defender Cassio

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Karma is an example shown but you can also play Invokers or Coven lose streak.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll on level 7 for Cassio 2 / Fiddle 2. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Then level to 8 for a duo carry.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Very BIS dependent. Can play from Coven Cashout. Can also play for Ornn 3 to potentially farm Artifacts. Always play 6 Defender. Duo carry on 8 is any 4 or 5 cost AP carry. Titans on fiddle because we have no other use for bow.

decks.title: Solar Blossom

sourceTips.tip: Slam items for Karma and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Sejuani 2.
Try to look for an econ/exp wisp every round when rolling. Prioritize Karma 3 > Sejuani 3 > Yorick 3 > Leblanc / Yunara 3. Leona / Kayle not necessary.
Finish your 3* then level for 3 Solar over time. Leftover AP items on LeBlanc. Karma 3 can also hold items too.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Prioritize 3* Karma + 3 Blossom + LeBlanc early for clone copies. Add 3 Solar after you finish your 3* (Leona / Kayle not necessary).

decks.title: Aphelios Nidalee

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.

decks.title: Elderwood Veigar

sourceTips.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar and Ornn 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish Ornn 3 and Veigar 3, you can slowroll on 6 for Leblanc + Alistar 3, if you are too far push levels..

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Play with lots of copies of Ornn and Veigar, we need to hit fast to start scaling. Sacrifice Lifebloom plant to Blackthorn early. Late game you can sacrifice Leblanc 3 for big stats -> move her items to another spellweaver. After you hit rush 9 for Kobuko + Gnar. After you cash out first Ornn artifact, move items to Alistar.

decks.title: Yi Rengar

sourceTips.tip: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Rengar 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Kog or a flex unit in at 8.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact.  VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3. Item priority: Master Yi/Rengar > Tank > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. Otherwise, Execute / Healing Primal. Rengar and Yi have the exact same BIS. Yi is stronger but itemize whoever is upgraded first.

decks.title: Draven Dragon 9

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Your duo carry with Elder Dragon is ideally Draven but its highly flexible. Can replace for Lux, Alune, Soraka for AP options.

decks.title: Aphelios Elderwood

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Ezreal, you should be stable with 7 elderwood and one of these 2 starred. Go 9 when stable for Gnar+Lux.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Comp to play with AD items and an elderwood emblem. If you hit elderwood lux with emblem you can drop Lillia for 9 Elderwood.

decks.title: Spellweaver Ahri

sourceTips.tip: Look for 3 Blossom early and play for win streak. Karma can hold items for Ahri. Itemize Yorick or any other 2* tank.
Flex in more Blossom or Spellweavers as you get them. You can tank all kinds of frontline: Juggernauts, Defenders, or Vanguards.
Level and roll for Ahri, Morgana, and the frontline. Once stable, go level 9 for Lux.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Ahri 2 > Cassio 2 > Ahri 1 > Alune for backline item distribution, this comp doesn't have enough frontline for Alune's moon. Only play with spellweaver emblem, lategame move emblem + Cass items onto Lux or Ivern 2.

decks.title: AP Fast 9

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with AP items. Ideal opener will be Blossom featuring Karma / Spellweavers.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Cap the board with a Lux over Morgana for end game. Lunar Lux is best but play whatever Lux you are likely to 2* first. Carry / tank 4 cost units until you get to the end game. Always focus on unit quality over exact board units.

decks.title: Solar Melee

sourceTips.tip: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.
Roll to 30 on 3-1 level 4 for extra 1 cost copies. Then slow roll on 5 until you have 5 3 stars for solar bonus.
Make sure you keep your econ high because you need to be level 7 to fit solar on this board. Try to be Level to 7 somewhere on stage 4.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Akali can be AD or AP (Flex IE/JG) Itemize Tank + 3star melee first -> 2nd melee -> Varus items. Only go for Kayle and Sej 3 with lots of money. Can  Swap out Ornn for Yorick/Rakan.

decks.title: Zyra Juggernaut

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Tank items for a win streak.
Ideally start holding more juggernauts to pair with the Yorick blossom opener, consider moving karma items to LB or Cassio 2.
Level and roll for 6 Juggernauts + Zyra and a duo-carry. You can push 9 when you hit Zyra 2. Tank Vi 2 over Amumu 1. End game move items to Maokai.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Turtle Primal buff. Composition is flexible as long as you get to the upgraded Juggernaut frontline. Best with Juggernaut emblem on Kennen. Prio Zyra Items > secondary carries. Sivir + Ashe is strong, but AP Nidalee or 5 costs like Ivern/Lux/Draven are also good.

decks.title: Malphite AP Flex

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so don't overly tunnel on your roll down.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Core is Malphite + Azir + 2 Flora Fatalis for healing. Play Ezreal or Zyra depending on items, it's not worth to play both usually compared to more frontline. If you hit blackthorn +1 or Blackthorn lux, drop the Kennen slot on 8 for Lux/Veigar, place blackthorn emblem on Zyra/Ezreal and then sacrifice Soraka instead of Fiddlesticks, and move her items to Azir 2.

decks.title: 10 Riftbeast

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Alpha Mark the Elder Dragon. Strong with any augment that gives you +1 team size so you can fit in another carry.

decks.title: Eclipse Kayle

sourceTips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items. Econ up as much as possible. Don't spend gold on leveling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Sejuani 3 > Leona 3 > Shen 3 / Varus 3. Once you finish Kayle 3, begin pushing levels for Lunar units.
Finish your 3* and level for Lunar units to get Eclipse in. Lunar Lux or Solar Lux are both good.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Roll on level 5 for 3* 1 costs, then level up to roll on 6 for 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*. When in doubt, add more tank and stall for Eclipse to kill units.

decks.title: Warwick Ravager

sourceTips.tip: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel. If you have Shojin + good component, play for win streak instead.
Level to 6 and roll for Warwick 2 with 4 Blackthorn + 2 Ravager. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can also play 4 Ravager temporarily if needed.
Finish Warwick 3 and push levels. If you don't have Murkwolf 3, look for Brambleback as your duo carry.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Aim to play a 3* unit in the Blackthorn center hex for max stats, preferably Krug 3. Leftover AD items on Murkwolf. Can also tank Rek'sai 3 if you can't find Malphite 2.

decks.title: Ashe Juggernauts

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak.
Level up for more juggernauts and executioners to pair with our blossom opener.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Sivir. Once stable, go 9 and look for Ashe and transition your board to 5 costs.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Consider this as a flex option for a Sivir board if you were playing around Juggernauts in the midgame already. If you get Juggernaut emblem, you can play 6 Juggernauts. Can also play other 5 cost AD carries like Dragon and Draven. Take turtle primal buff.

decks.title: Azir Reroll

sourceTips.tip: Try to angle this comp with early Azir ideally with blossom opener for better charms.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Make sure you have 2* Azir, Kha and Vi on 4-1, then slowroll above 50 for 3 stars. Make sure Kha has 8 takedowns before feeding to blackthorn, 3 executioner is very important.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: More of an Azir comp than a Khazix comp, we just want executioner buff than we feed Kha to blackthorn hex for offensive Azir Stacks. If you have lots of Kha upgrades drop Sett + Reksai for Ahri + WW/Malphite for Spellweaver+Ravager. With enough mana gen from blackthorn, Azir doesn't need attack speed, but Rageblade is okay on him.

decks.title: Blackthorn Malphite

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Malphite items for a win streak.
Add in useful 3 costs like Fiddlesticks, Cassio, Azir then flex around their traits. General rule: put items on upgraded units.
Level and roll for Malphite. You will often have to itemize and work with whoever you hit so be flexible. Once stable on Azir 2, Zyra, and Malphite, push to 9.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Sacrifice a high quality unit like 2* 4 cost Soraka so you can get lots of Mana + Damage Amp for your Blackthorn carries. Blackthorn Lux caps the board very high, but you can also play Alune instead.

decks.title: Fae Ezreal

sourceTips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Don't play 4 fae in the midgame until you have at least 4 pixie stats. Level for more elderwoods/frontline and save gold.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Lillia for 4 Fae. Roll aggressively for 2 stars on level 8 because Fae can give us gold later..

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Only play with fae emblem, Can drop Soraka + Hecarim + Fiddlesticks for Aphelios + Ornn + Diana.

decks.title: Aphelios Rapidfire

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. All ad items are good slams besides rageblade.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Only strong with +1 Rapidfire, play another version if you have it. Don't need much attack speed with 5 rapidfire.

decks.title: Woodblossom

sourceTips.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Ezreal and the 4 costs, only go 9 once you have upgraded most things.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Best with Executioner emblem. Focus Ezreal + Tank items first then rest on Ahri->Soraka. Elderwood Lux caps the board.

decks.title: Aphelios Vanguards

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Core units are Aphelios + Diana + Sentinel + Mama Beak. Red Buff is BIS Aphelios but you can also play Rageblade build. Play Scuttlecrab + Rakan over Brambleback if no melee items. Can duo carry Zyra or Morgana if extra AP items.

decks.title: Afaelios

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Can also play Elderwood with Ornn + Xayah + Hecarim.
Level to 8 and roll for Aphelios and Lillia. Prioritize upgrades before pushing levels to 9.

decks.sourceAugmentTip: Comp to play with AD items and a Fae emblem. If you hit Fae Lux with emblem you can drop Xayah and Rakan for better units.

recommendations.title: 협곡야수 템포

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Brambleback items. Murkwolf can hold items.
Aim to get 7 Riftbeast online latest by Stage 3-5. Use free Riftbeast shops to upgrade only instead of rerolling. Finish Bramble / tank items.
Level to 8 and look for Bramble + Brawler or Rakan. Always play Elder Dragon when you hit. Once stable, go 9 for another 5 cost.

recommendations.sourceAugmentTip: Alpha Mark the Brambleback. Strong with any augment that gives you +1 team size so you can fit in another carry.

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively on Kha'zix and move them later. It's okay to have Spark, Shojin, etc on Khazix early for takedowns.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, give leftover AP items to Diana.

recommendations.sourceAugmentTip: If you have HOJ first, go Executioner > Ravager. If you have AP / Mana / tempo slams, go Ravager > Executioner. Then pick Spellweaver > Rapidfire with the last evolutions. Can play 3rd Executioner/Lux/Ivern as max cap.

sourceTips.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Pebbles items. Alpha Mark Crab or Gromp.
Save up econ and try to go level 7  for 7 riftbeast on 3-5, if you're poor wait until 4-1.

sourceTips.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

recommendations.sourceAugmentTip: Position Nidalee on weak side to get a quick kill then jump backline. Amumu or Sentinel 2 can be your main tank (you're often contested so prioritize whichever gets upgraded). Kogmaw Provides Free Shred + Sunder.

sourceTips.tip: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.

recommendations.sourceAugmentTip: +1 tier in strength with Artifact.  VI 3 is stronger than Krug 3. Item priority: Master Yi/Rengar > Tank > Nidalee. Only take Phoenix Primal buff if ahead. recommendations.title: 일식 케일

sourceTips.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items. Econ up as much as possible. Don't spend gold on leveling.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Sejuani 3 > Leona 3 > Shen 3 / Varus 3. Once you finish Kayle 3, begin pushing levels for Lunar units.
Finish your 3* and level for Lunar units to get Eclipse in. Lunar Lux or Solar Lux are both good.

recommendations.sourceAugmentTip: Roll on level 5 for 3* 1 costs, then level up to roll on 6 for 3*. Kayle has built in 20% Shred at 2*. When in doubt, add more tank and stall for Eclipse to kill units.

methodology: 배치·아이템·증강은 동일한 최신 Academy 공략을 그대로 사용. 5개 출처 각 20~30개를 비교. Academy 티어 점수(S100/A75/B50/C25)에 LoLCHESS 일치 +5, MetaTFT 평균 등수 보정 0~5를 합산. OP.GG는 핫픽스 반영 미확인, QQ는 지역 버전 차이로 티어 점수에 합산하지 않고 비교만 표시. 표시 티어는 Academy 원문 티어. MetaTFT는 공개 데이터에 S/A/B가 없어 통계만 비교.
